caveats: Whole-card memory is not a per-process measurement.
CUDA/DGL/driver allocations outside the Torch allocator belong partly to this process.
Context initialization differences can include concurrent changes by other processes.
Later lazy library allocations are not necessarily included in the initial context observation.
Peak reserved and minimum free are not necessarily observed at the same instant.
Total, used, and free may not sum due to driver/system reservations; raw readings are retained.

context_observation.warmup: one-element Torch CUDA tensor and one-node one-edge DGL CUDA graph; no RNG draws

epoch_timing.caveat: A duration above twice the first-three-epoch median is only a possible memory-spill warning. Checkpoint I/O, initialization, CPU/system load, and other GPU activity can also explain a slowdown. Whole-card samples and allocator/context arithmetic do not prove memory paging.
epoch_timing.comparison_rule: epoch >= 3 and seconds > 2 * fixed first-three median
